metadata.name: file_io_toolbox
metadata.description: A toolbox for file I/O operations.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.__init__
functions.description: Initializes the FileIoToolbox. Currently, no specific initialization parameters are required.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.read_file
functions.description: Reads the entire content of a file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

returns.description: The content of the file as a string, or None if an error occurs.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.write_file
functions.description: Writes content to a file. Can overwrite or append.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to write.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: If True, overwrites the file. If False, appends to the file.

returns.description: True if writing was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.create_empty_file
functions.description: Creates a new empty file. If the file already exists, it will be truncated.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file to create.

returns.description: True if creation was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.append_to_file
functions.description: Appends content to an existing file. If the file does not exist, it creates it.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to append.

returns.description: True if appending was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.are_files_equal
functions.description: Checks if the content of two files is equal.

parameters.name: file_path1
parameters.description: Path to the first file.

parameters.name: file_path2
parameters.description: Path to the second file.

parameters.name: shallow
parameters.description: If True (default), performs a shallow comparison (metadata, size). If False, performs a byte-by-byte content comparison.

returns.description: True if files are equal, False if not, None if one or both files don't exist.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.find_string_in_file
functions.description: Checks if a specific string exists within a file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: search_string
parameters.description: The string to search for.

returns.description: True if the string is found, False otherwise or if an error occurs.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.extract_python_components
functions.description: Extracts top-level functions and class names from a Python file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the Python file.

returns.description: A dictionary with 'functions' and 'classes' lists, or None if parsing fails or file not found.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.is_valid_json
functions.description: Checks if a file contains valid JSON.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

returns.description: True if the file is valid JSON, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.is_valid_csv
functions.description: Attempts to validate if a file is a well-formed CSV. This is a basic check; complex CSVs might require more sophisticated validation.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: The delimiter used in the CSV.

parameters.name: quotechar
parameters.description: The quote character used.

returns.description: True if the file seems to be a valid CSV, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.parse_json_file
functions.description: Parses a JSON file into a Python dictionary or list.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the JSON file.

returns.description: The parsed JSON data, or None if an error occurs.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.write_json
functions.description: Writes a Python dictionary or list to a file as JSON.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file to write.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data to serialize as JSON.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: If True, overwrites the file. If False, appends (not typical for JSON files).

returns.description: True if writing was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.parse_csv_file
functions.description: Parses a CSV file into a list of lists or list of dictionaries.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the CSV file.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: The delimiter used in the CSV file.

parameters.name: as_dict
parameters.description: If True, parses CSV into a list of dictionaries using the first row as keys. If False (default), parses into a list of lists.

returns.description: A list of lists (or list of dicts) representing the CSV data, or None if an error occurs.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.modify_line_in_file
functions.description: Modifies a specific line in a text file. Line numbers are 1-indexed.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: line_number
parameters.description: The 1-indexed line number to modify.

parameters.name: new_content
parameters.description: The new content for the line (without newline character).

returns.description: True if modification was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.delete_file_contents
functions.description: Deletes all content from a file (truncates it).

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

returns.description: True if successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.delete_file
functions.description: Deletes a file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file to delete.

returns.description: True if deletion was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.get_file_size
functions.description: Gets the size of a file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: human_readable
parameters.description: If True, returns size in a human-readable format (KB, MB, GB).

returns.description: Size in bytes (int), or human-readable string, or None if file not found.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.file_exists
functions.description: Checks if a file exists and is actually a file.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.dir_exists
functions.description: Checks if a directory exists and is actually a directory.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.create_directory
functions.description: Creates a directory.

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: The path for the directory to be created.

parameters.name: exist_ok
parameters.description: If True, does not raise an error if the directory already exists.

returns.description: True if directory was created or already existed (with exist_ok=True), False on error.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.list_directory_contents
functions.description: Lists contents (files and directories) of a given directory. Optionally filters by a simple wildcard pattern (e.g., "*.txt").

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: The path to the directory.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Optional wildcard pattern to filter results.

returns.description: A list of names of files and directories, or None if directory doesn't exist.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.copy_file
functions.description: Copies a file from source to destination. Destination can be a directory (file will be copied into it with same name) or a full file path (file will be copied and possibly renamed).

parameters.name: src_path
parameters.description: Path to the source file.

parameters.name: dest_path
parameters.description: Path to the destination file or directory.

returns.description: True if copy was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.move_file
functions.description: Moves (renames) a file from source to destination.

parameters.name: src_path
parameters.description: Path to the source file.

parameters.name: dest_path
parameters.description: Path to the destination file or directory.

returns.description: True if move was successful, False otherwise.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.prepare_ast_script_function
functions.description: Prepares a specific top-level function from a Python file for later execution. This function loads the module and retrieves the function object. It does NOT execute the function itself. Module-level code in the file WILL execute.

parameters.name: function_node
parameters.description: The ast.FunctionDef node of the function to prepare.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the Python file containing the function.

returns.description: A callable function object ready to be executed.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.prepare_ast_class_method
functions.description: Prepares a specific method of a class from a Python file for later execution. This function loads the module, instantiates the class (executing its __init__), and retrieves the bound method. It does NOT execute the method itself.

parameters.name: class_node
parameters.description: The ast.ClassDef node of the class containing the method.

parameters.name: method_node
parameters.description: The ast.FunctionDef node of the method to prepare.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The path to the Python file containing the class and method.

parameters.name: instance_args
parameters.description: A tuple of positional arguments for the class constructor (__init__).

parameters.name: instance_kwargs
parameters.description: A dictionary of keyword arguments for the class constructor.

returns.description: A tuple containing: - A callable bound method ready to be executed. - An instance of the class.

functions.name: file_io_toolbox.FileIoToolbox.prepare_ast_class_method_for_instance
functions.description: Prepares a specific method of a class instance for later execution. This function retrieves the bound method from the instance.
